name: meok-compliance-gateway
description: MEOK Compliance Gateway — the keystone of the CSOAI-ORG fleet. Streamable-HTTP at /mcp with Ed25519 sigils, x402 per-call USDC billing, and audit-anchor chains. 6 tools: 4 free observability + 2 paywalled. Built by MEOK AI Labs.
author: MEOK AI Labs

tools.name: list_experts
tools.description: List the 14 OpenScore safety experts. Free, top-of-funnel, 5 calls/day per caller.

tools.name: spending_report
tools.description: Return the keystone's x402 spending report (free observability, 20 calls/day per caller).

tools.name: audit_anchor
tools.description: Return the keystone's tamper-evident audit-anchor chain tail + head (free observability).

tools.name: health
tools.description: Keystone health + version info (free, no payment required).

tools.name: sign_receipt
tools.description: COST WARNING: $0.05 per call — Sign a SHA-256 hash and return a Signet receipt.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: COST WARNING: $0.05 per call — Verify a Signet receipt by id and re-compute the HMAC.

attestation_id.description: The receipt ID returned by sign_receipt
